name: Felt Maps
description: Felt is a modern GIS platform for creating, analyzing, and sharing interactive maps. The Felt MCP server lets Claude run geospatial analysis end-to-end: query connected databases and storage (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, S3) with spatial SQL, build and style map layers with Felt Style Language (FSL), upload files, manage annotations like pins and polygons, share maps, and tap into Felt's curated library of public datasets covering boundaries, demographics, infrastructure, and climate.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Felt Maps to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Felt Maps to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://felt.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Felt Maps MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Felt Maps lists 34 MCP tools, including who_am_i, create_map, get_map, update_map, delete_map, list_maps, share_map, get_map_layers, get_layer_properties, update_layer_properties, delete_layer, and duplicate_layer_to_map.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Felt Maps?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Felt Maps in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Felt Maps MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Felt Maps requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Felt Maps is developed by Felt Maps. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
